verdict.rationale: Anytype documents custom Types as blueprints that define what an Object is. It stores data as Properties on Objects, as with bookmark metadata, and Queries retrieve Objects by user-defined criteria into live Views. Together these cover typed attributes applied consistently for organization and retrieval. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of tag/multi-select properties, detail on defining custom property types and filtering Queries by them, and independent hands-on corroboration of property/tag workflows.
